name: Damon Elliott
description: '''Damon William Elliott''' (born March 21, 1973) is an American record producer, songwriter and composer. Throughout his career he has worked with various artists spanning across [[Hip hop music|hip hop]], [[Contemporary R&B|R&B]], [[Pop music|pop]], [[pop rock]], [[Gospel music|gospel]], [[reggae]] and [[Country music|country]]. He also produced the [[Academy Awards|Academy Award]]-nominated song "Applause" from the 2022 film ''[[Tell It Like a Woman]]''. Elliott is the son of [[Dionne Warwick]] and [[William Elliott (actor, born 1934)|Bill Elliott]].
